steps.en: Install the extension from your browser's add-on store, then reload your webmail
steps.zh: 从浏览器扩展商店装好，再刷新网页邮箱

steps.en: Switch the compose box to its rich editor and type the email in plain Markdown
steps.zh: 把撰写框切到富文本模式，用纯 Markdown 写邮件

steps.en: Trigger the toggle on the whole body or on a selection
steps.zh: 对整封邮件或选中的一段触发转换

steps.en: Renders that Markdown to HTML in place, with highlighted fenced code blocks
steps.zh: 就地把 Markdown 渲染成 HTML，代码块带语法高亮

steps.en: Leaves quoted reply text alone and remembers the source, so toggling again reverts
steps.zh: 不动回复里引用的原邮件，并记住原文，再按一次就还原

value.en: Recipients get a formatted email with real code blocks; you never touched the toolbar or pasted from another editor
value.zh: 收件人看到排版好、带代码块的邮件，你没碰过工具栏，也不用从别的编辑器复制粘贴

sources: https://github.com/adam-p/markdown-here#usage-instructions (rich editor, Thunderbird 'Compose messages in HTML format', Markdown Toggle, SHIFT+ALT+M)
https://github.com/adam-p/markdown-here#revert-to-markdown and #replies (toggle back; existing blockquote blocks left intact)
